name: react-native-best-practices
headline: TypeScript Boilerplate for AI Agents -
short_description: The ai-coding-project-boilerplate provides a strong TypeScript framework tailored for Claude Code, enabling developers to efficiently create and manage specialized AI agents. This production-ready boilerplate enhances productivity and streamlines the development workflow.
author: shinpr

sections.overview:
The ai-coding-project-boilerplate is a TypeScript framework purpose-built for Claude Code that helps developers create production-ready AI agent projects without context exhaustion. It implements sub-agent architecture, where specialized agents handle distinct roles like design, implementation, and review—each with fresh context windows. The boilerplate includes pre-configured slash commands (/implement, /task, /design, /plan, /build, /review), a skills system for project-specific customization, and automatic context injection via /project-inject. It supports Node.js 22+ and TypeScript 5.x, with built-in workflows that keep code quality checks fast by running locally rather than in CI. Teams benefit from standardized agentic coding workflows that scale across larger projects without quality degradation.
Creating AI-driven applications
Rapid prototyping of AI agents
Streamlining TypeScript project setup
Enhancing developer productivity
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
